slides.title: Professional Phone Calls
slides.content:
1. Identifying Yourself

On the phone, we don't say "I am...". We say:

  • "Hello, this is Alex speaking." (Standard)
  • "Good morning, OnixLingo, Alex speaking." (Reception)

2. Key Phrasal Verbs

Pick up: Answer the phone.
Hang up: End the call.
Hold on: Wait a moment.
Put through: Connect/Transfer.
slides.speech_text: Speaking on the phone can be stressful without visual cues. Remember: use 'This is' to identify yourself. Use 'Hold on' to ask someone to wait, and 'Put you through' when transferring a call.

slides.title: Taking a Message
slides.content: Listen to the receptionist handling a call for an absent manager.
slides.audio_script:
Receptionist: Good morning, TechSolutions. How can I help you?
        Caller: Hello, this is David Miller. Could I speak to Mr. Johnson, please?
        Receptionist: One moment, please... I'm afraid Mr. Johnson is in a meeting.
        Caller: Oh, I see.
        Receptionist: Would you like to leave a message?
        Caller: Yes, please ask him to call me back before 5 PM.
        Receptionist: Certainly. Does he have your number?
        Caller: Yes, he does. Thank you.

quiz.question: Why can't Mr. Johnson answer?
options: He is not in the office

slides.title: Match the Phrase
slides.instruction: Select the correct phrase for each situation.

questions.text: Situation: You need the caller to wait.
questions.explanation: 'Could you hold on?' es la forma estándar y educada de pedir una espera.

questions.text: Situation: You didn't hear the name clearly.
questions.explanation: Siempre usa 'Could you...' para peticiones. 'Repeat' directo suena a orden.

questions.text: Situation: You are connecting the call to the boss.
questions.explanation: 'Put through' es el phrasal verb específico para transferir llamadas.

slides.title: Roleplay: The Gatekeeper
slides.system_prompt:
You are a busy client named Mr. Carter calling a company.
        The user is the Receptionist.
        
        Steps:
        1. Say: "Hello, this is Mr. Carter. Is Sarah available?"
        2. Wait for the user to say she is busy/unavailable.
        3. Say: "Oh, okay. Can I leave a message?"
        4. Dictate: "Please tell her the contract is ready."
        5. Wait for confirmation.
        
        Goal: The user must be polite, use "I'm afraid she is busy" or similar, and confirm the message.
slides.initial_message: Ring ring... (You pick up the phone)
slides.user_goal: Answer professionally (e.g., 'Company Name, [Name] speaking') and handle the call.
